verdict.rationale: Muse's docs claim it has its own computer/file system/terminal and can write code and build tools on demand (muse-docs-1, muse-docs-7), which supports general code-execution capability, but there is no concrete evidence of it producing charts, computed answers, or downloadable files specifically. A community report also shows the agent's control plane timing out under stress, suggesting reliability issues for complex agentic tasks. missing for 10: evidence of actual chart generation, computed answer output, downloadable file creation, and independent confirmation these work reliably at scale.
